goal: Final Build: 9 Active Avengers + Router + Dashboard

tasks.title: Create Avenger Registry (19 Avengers, 9 active)
tasks.prompt: Create a JSON registry of 19 Avengers. Active: PEPPER_POTTS, CAP, HAPPY, IRON_MAN, THOR, DOCTOR_STRANGE, HAWK_EYE, SPIDER_MAN, BLACK_PANTHER. Inactive: ANT_MAN, WASP, VISION, SCARLET_WITCH, WAR_MACHINE, FALCON, WINTER_SOLDIER, SHURI, OKOYE, M_BAKU. Each entry must have: id, name, status (active/inactive), repo_path, api_key_env, income_ytd, last_run.

tasks.title: Activate PEPPER POTTS (Finance Tracker)
tasks.prompt: Create a Python module that connects the Finance ledger to the Avenger registry. Add functions: log_avenger_income(avenger_id, amount, description) and log_avenger_cost(avenger_id, amount, description). Both must write to finance/ledger.py and update the avenger's income_ytd.

tasks.title: Build the 8 Active Connectors
tasks.prompt: Create a single Python file with 8 functions: run_cap(task), run_happy(task), run_iron_man(task), run_thor(task), run_doctor_strange(task), run_hawk_eye(task), run_spider_man(task), run_black_panther(task). Each function should read the avenger's repo_path from config/avengers.json, execute it via subprocess, and return a status string. Add safety checks: only run if status is 'active'.

tasks.title: Build the Router
tasks.prompt: Create a JARVIS action tool called router. It accepts parameters: avenger_id and task. It looks up the avenger in config/avengers.json, then calls the corresponding function in avengers/connectors.py. Return the result. Include a TOOL dict so it auto-registers.

tasks.title: Build the Visual Dashboard
tasks.prompt: Create a Flask app with a single route '/' that renders an HTML dashboard. It must read config/avengers.json and display 19 avenger cards (green for active, grey for inactive). Also read finance/ledger.py and display total revenue and last 5 transactions. Include inline HTML/CSS in the same file.
